text_blocks.snippet: RT-PCR (Reverse Transcription Polymerase Chain Reaction) tests are a reliable method for detecting COVID-19. They are considered highly accurate because they test for the virus's specific genetic material, minimizing interference from other viruses. This test is commonly performed using a nasal swab. RT-PCR is also used to detect influenza viruses, as they are also RNA viruses.
